subject: VPC fee & support packaging for Medisphere — options and SOW next steps
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@medisphere.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@medisphere.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:22:00 -0500
Subject: VPC packaging questions and fee split

Jonas,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — I spoke with the infra and procurement teams and we have a few open questions before we move to legal:

1) Can you break out the components of the upfront platform fee vs. the ongoing node/operator licenses? We need a line-item view we can include in our CapEx request.
2) For a 2-year commitment, what concession/discounts are you able to offer? Procurement prefers amortizing platform fees over the contract rather than a single up-front invoice.
3) Our deployment will be multi-region (US + EU). Are operator licenses per-site or can they be pooled with a regional cap?
4) Clarify support tiers: we need guaranteed SLAs for production inference (4ms p50 on critical paths) and an SRE retainer option for the first 90 days of rollout.

Can you send a few packaging options (pilot, committed, enterprise) and a draft SOW we can circulate? If you can include attachment stubs (pricing spreadsheet and SOW) that would be ideal.

Thanks,
Alex Green
Director of Infrastructure
Medisphere Health
alex.green@medisphere.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@medisphere.com>
Cc: procure@medisphere.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC packaging questions and fee split

Alex — appreciated the time. Attaching two artifacts that should help: a one-page pricing scenarios PDF and an initial SOW draft for a US+EU pilot. Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Pricing_Scenarios_Q1.pdf (pricing scenarios), Proposed_SOW_Draft.docx (SOW skeleton).

High level — three options we recommend:

- Option A (Pilot): 6-month pilot, no platform amortization. Platform fee invoiced up-front, small pilot discount (10%) for first 3 months of support. Meant for quick validation with limited nodes.

- Option B (Committed 2yr) — recommended for Medisphere: 2-year commitment, platform fee amortized monthly over term. We can offer a 20% concession on the platform fee if you: (1) sign a 24-month SOW, (2) commit to minimum reserved capacity of 24 nodes across regions, and (3) accept operator license pooling with a regional cap (max concurrency per-region enforced). Support: Silver tier (4h business response, 24/7 critical path monitoring) + optional 90-day SRE retainer (4 weeks of on-call onboarding + 8 weeks remote runbook).

- Option C (Enterprise): 3-year commitment, deeper discount on platform fee (30%) and bump to Gold support (1h critical response, dedicated TAM), includes conversion credits for future expansions and a discounted operator license rate for burst capacity.

Notes on licensing pooling: operator licenses can be pooled by region with a soft cap and throttling-based fallback to lower-cost model variants if concurrency exceeds threshold — this keeps per-region economics predictable while allowing burst across sites.

Next steps: if Option B looks good I can circulate an updated SOW with the amortization schedule and exact SKU IDs. Will need a procurement contact and target sign date to hold pricing.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Lead — Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Pricing_Scenarios_Q1.pdf; Proposed_SOW_Draft.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 11:30:00 -0500
Subject: Re: VPC packaging questions and fee split (internal)

Jonas / Laura — quick internal note on Option B:

- I support the 2-year amortization but recommend we scope the SRE retainer tightly: 40 hours/week for the first 4 weeks, then on-call handover. Keep the retainer as an add-on SKU so we don't inflate base support.
- Make the 20% platform concession conditional on both the reserved-node minimum and an agreed SLA baseline (p99 latency guardrail + rolling regressions alerting).
- On operator license pooling: restrict the pooled cap to avoid unbounded risk — suggest a hard cap per-region (e.g., 60% of reserved capacity) and automatic scale-to-burst pricing for true overages.

I'll draft language for the SOW that limits the concession to the platform fee line only (not operator-license per-token usage). Send me the SOW with the amortization table and I will annotate.

Ben Carter
Head, Customer Solutions — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: VPC packaging questions and fee split (internal escalation)

Team — fine to approve Option B concession as discussed, but finance and legal need the following before we commit:

- Finance: amortization schedule and invoice cadence (monthly journal entries, single invoice with amortization memo).
- Legal: updated SOW with a termination-for-convenience clause and a performance SLA appendix.
- Limit the concession to platform fee only (no discount on operator license or premium support).

Jonas — please prepare the updated SOW with the amortization table and mark the concession as conditional on sign + reserved-node minimum. I'll loop in legal (cc: legal@redwood.ai) after you send. Also copy the procurement contact at Medisphere when you send the SOW.

Laura Bennett
VP, Commercial — Redwood Inference

From: Alex Green <alex.green@medisphere.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@medisphere.com, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Jan 2026 14:09:00 +0000
Subject: Re: VPC packaging questions and fee split

Jonas / Laura — thanks for the clear options and internal readout. Medisphere is prepared to move forward with Option B (2-year committed, amortized platform fee) subject to the following:

- Updated SOW showing monthly amortization and invoice cadence.
- Confirmation that the 20% platform concession applies only to the platform fee line and will be applied to the amortized monthly invoices.
- The 90-day SRE retainer included as an optional add-on SKU — we want visibility into hours and ramp plan.
- Legal asks to see the SLA appendix and termination language (we will share our commercial counsel contact if needed).

Please send the revised SOW and a DocuSign link and we will route to our procurement and legal teams. Target: internal sign-off by Feb 5 so we can begin pilot planning.

Best,
Alex Green
Director of Infrastructure
Medisphere Health
alex.green@medisphere.com

Attachments referenced: Proposed_SOW_Draft.docx (please update); Redwood_VPC_Pricing_Scenarios_Q1.pdf (pricing scenarios)
